# Harmonium — Complete API Reference

Harmonium is a React component library with typed props, design-token theming via CSS custom properties, and accessible defaults. All components use `forwardRef`, accept a `className` prop (merged last for easy overrides), and use `data-*` attributes for variant styling.

## Setup

```bash
npm install harmonium
```

```tsx
import { Button, Card, CardBody, Input } from 'harmonium'
import 'harmonium/styles.css'
```

Theme by overriding CSS custom properties:
```css
:root {
  --harmonium-color-brand-primary: #E91E63;
  --harmonium-color-brand-secondary: #9C27B0;
  --harmonium-radius-md: 8px;
  --harmonium-font-family-sans: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}
```

Dark mode:
```css
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --harmonium-color-bg: #1a1a1a;
  --harmonium-color-text: #f0f0f0;
  --harmonium-color-surface: #2d2d2d;
  --harmonium-color-border: #404040;
}
```

---

## Button

Import: `import { Button } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<button>` HTML attributes):
- variant: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' (default: 'primary')
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')
- expanded: boolean — full-width button

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Save</Button>
<Button variant="outline" disabled>Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={handleClick}>Edit</Button>
<Button variant="secondary" expanded>Full Width</Button>
```

---

## Stack

Import: `import { Stack } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- direction: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' (default: 'vertical')
- gap: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (default: 'md')
- align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'
- justify: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between' | 'around'
- wrap: boolean

```tsx
<Stack gap="lg">
  <Input placeholder="Name" />
  <Input placeholder="Email" />
  <Button>Submit</Button>
</Stack>

<Stack direction="horizontal" gap="sm" align="center">
  <Avatar src="/photo.jpg" />
  <span>Jane Doe</span>
</Stack>
```

---

## Group

Import: `import { Group } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- gap: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (default: 'md')
- align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'
- justify: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between' | 'around'
- wrap: boolean
- grow: boolean — children fill available space

```tsx
<Group justify="end" gap="sm">
  <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
  <Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
</Group>
```

---

## Grid + GridCol

Import: `import { Grid, GridCol } from 'harmonium'`

Grid props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- columns: number | string (default: 12) — number sets repeat(N, 1fr), string used as-is
- gap: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (default: 'md')
- align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'

GridCol props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- span: number | string — number sets span N, string used as-is

```tsx
<Grid columns={12} gap="md">
  <GridCol span={8}>
    <Card><CardBody>Main content</CardBody></Card>
  </GridCol>
  <GridCol span={4}>
    <Card><CardBody>Sidebar</CardBody></Card>
  </GridCol>
</Grid>
```

---

## Separator

Import: `import { Separator } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<hr>` HTML attributes):
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' (default: 'horizontal')
- spacing: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (default: 'md')

```tsx
<Stack>
  <p>Section one</p>
  <Separator />
  <p>Section two</p>
</Stack>
```

---

## Card + CardHeader + CardBody + CardFooter

Import: `import { Card, CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter } from 'harmonium'`

Card props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- variant: 'elevated' | 'outlined' | 'filled' (default: 'elevated')
- padding: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter: extend `<div>` HTML attributes, no custom props.

```tsx
<Card variant="outlined">
  <CardHeader>User Profile</CardHeader>
  <CardBody>
    <p>Name: Jane Doe</p>
    <p>Email: jane@example.com</p>
  </CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <Group justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
      <Button>Save</Button>
    </Group>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

---

## Badge

Import: `import { Badge } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<span>` HTML attributes):
- variant: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral' (default: 'neutral')
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

```tsx
<Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge variant="error" size="sm">Overdue</Badge>
```

---

## Alert

Import: `import { Alert } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- variant: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' (default: 'info')
- dismissible: boolean
- onDismiss: () => void

```tsx
<Alert variant="success" dismissible onDismiss={() => setShow(false)}>
  Changes saved successfully.
</Alert>
<Alert variant="error">Something went wrong.</Alert>
```

---

## Progress

Import: `import { Progress } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, renders with role="progressbar"):
- value: number (default: 0)
- max: number (default: 100)
- variant: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' (default: 'primary')
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')
- showLabel: boolean

```tsx
<Progress value={75} max={100} showLabel />
<Progress value={30} variant="warning" size="sm" />
```

---

## Spinner

Import: `import { Spinner } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<span>` HTML attributes):
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')
- label: string (default: 'Loading') — accessible label for screen readers

```tsx
<Spinner size="lg" />
<Spinner size="sm" label="Saving" />
```

---

## Avatar

Import: `import { Avatar } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<span>` HTML attributes):
- src: string — image URL
- alt: string (default: '')
- fallback: string — text shown when no image (e.g. initials)
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' (default: 'md')

```tsx
<Avatar src="/photo.jpg" alt="Jane Doe" size="lg" />
<Avatar fallback="JD" size="md" />
```

---

## Skeleton

Import: `import { Skeleton } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, renders aria-hidden="true"):
- width: string | number
- height: string | number
- variant: 'text' | 'circular' | 'rectangular' (default: 'text')

```tsx
<Skeleton width="100%" height={20} />
<Skeleton variant="circular" width={48} height={48} />
<Skeleton variant="rectangular" width="100%" height={200} />
```

---

## Table + TableHead + TableBody + TableRow + TableHeader + TableCell

Import: `import { Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell } from 'harmonium'`

Table props (extends `<table>` HTML attributes):
- striped: boolean
- hoverable: boolean
- responsive: boolean

TableHead, TableBody: extend their respective HTML section attributes, no custom props.
TableRow: extends `<tr>` HTML attributes, no custom props.
TableHeader: extends `<th>` HTML attributes, no custom props.
TableCell: extends `<td>` HTML attributes, no custom props.

```tsx
<Table striped hoverable>
  <TableHead>
    <TableRow>
      <TableHeader>Name</TableHeader>
      <TableHeader>Email</TableHeader>
      <TableHeader>Role</TableHeader>
    </TableRow>
  </TableHead>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell>Jane Doe</TableCell>
      <TableCell>jane@example.com</TableCell>
      <TableCell>Admin</TableCell>
    </TableRow>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

---

## DataGrid

Import: `import { DataGrid } from 'harmonium'`
Types: `import type { DataGridColumn, SortState } from 'harmonium'`

Generic component `DataGrid<T>`. Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- columns: DataGridColumn<T>[] — required
- data: T[] — required
- rowKey: (row: T) => string | number — required
- sort: SortState | null — controlled sort state
- onSortChange: (sort: SortState) => void
- striped: boolean
- hoverable: boolean

DataGridColumn<T>:
- key: string — required
- header: string — required
- render: (row: T) => React.ReactNode — optional, falls back to String(row[key])
- sortable: boolean
- width: string

SortState: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' | null }

```tsx
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email' },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', render: (row) => <Badge>{row.role}</Badge> },
]

<DataGrid
  columns={columns}
  data={users}
  rowKey={(row) => row.id}
  sort={sort}
  onSortChange={setSort}
  striped
  hoverable
/>
```

---

## Tabs + TabsList + TabsTrigger + TabsContent

Import: `import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from 'harmonium'`

Tabs props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — controlled active tab
- defaultValue: string — uncontrolled initial tab
- onValueChange: (value: string) => void

TabsList: extends `<div>` HTML attributes, no custom props.

TabsTrigger props (extends `<button>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — required, tab ID

TabsContent props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — required, tab ID

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="general">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="security">Security</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="notifications">Notifications</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="general">General settings...</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="security">Security settings...</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="notifications">Notification preferences...</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

---

## Accordion + AccordionItem + AccordionTrigger + AccordionContent

Import: `import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from 'harmonium'`

Accordion props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- multiple: boolean — allow multiple items open
- value: string | string[] — controlled
- defaultValue: string | string[] — uncontrolled
- onValueChange: (value: string[]) => void

AccordionItem props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — required, unique item ID

AccordionTrigger props (extends `<button>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — required, item value this trigger controls

AccordionContent props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- value: string — required, item value this content belongs to

```tsx
<Accordion defaultValue="faq-1">
  <AccordionItem value="faq-1">
    <AccordionTrigger value="faq-1">What is Harmonium?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent value="faq-1">
      A React component library with design-token theming.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="faq-2">
    <AccordionTrigger value="faq-2">How do I theme it?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent value="faq-2">
      Override --harmonium-* CSS custom properties.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

---

## Breadcrumbs + BreadcrumbItem

Import: `import { Breadcrumbs, BreadcrumbItem } from 'harmonium'`

Breadcrumbs props (extends `<nav>` HTML attributes):
- separator: React.ReactNode (default: '/')

BreadcrumbItem props (extends `<a>` HTML attributes):
- active: boolean — renders as `<span>` when true (current page)

```tsx
<Breadcrumbs>
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/">Home</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/settings">Settings</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem active>Profile</BreadcrumbItem>
</Breadcrumbs>
```

---

## Pagination

Import: `import { Pagination } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<nav>` HTML attributes):
- page: number — required, 1-based current page
- totalPages: number — required
- onPageChange: (page: number) => void — required
- maxVisible: number (default: 5) — max visible page buttons

```tsx
<Pagination page={currentPage} totalPages={10} onPageChange={setCurrentPage} />
```

## TopBar + TopBarSection

Import: `import { TopBar, TopBarSection } from 'harmonium'`

TopBar props (extends `<header>` HTML attributes):
- fixed: boolean — sticky positioning

TopBarSection props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' (default: 'left')

```tsx
<TopBar>
  <TopBarSection align="left">
    <strong>My App</strong>
  </TopBarSection>
  <TopBarSection align="right">
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Settings</Button>
    <Avatar src="/me.jpg" size="sm" />
  </TopBarSection>
</TopBar>
```

## Dialog + DialogHeader + DialogBody + DialogFooter

Import: `import { Dialog, DialogHeader, DialogBody, DialogFooter } from 'harmonium'`

Dialog props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- open: boolean
- onClose: () => void
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'full' (default: 'md')

DialogHeader, DialogBody, DialogFooter: extend `<div>` HTML attributes, no custom props.

```tsx
<Dialog open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} size="md">
  <DialogHeader>Confirm Delete</DialogHeader>
  <DialogBody>
    <p>Are you sure you want to delete this item?</p>
  </DialogBody>
  <DialogFooter>
    <Group justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</Button>
    </Group>
  </DialogFooter>
</Dialog>
```

## Drawer

Import: `import { Drawer } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- open: boolean
- onClose: () => void
- side: 'left' | 'right' (default: 'right')
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

```tsx
<Drawer open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} side="right" size="md">
  <h2>Drawer Title</h2>
  <p>Drawer content goes here.</p>
</Drawer>
```

## Tooltip

Import: `import { Tooltip } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, excluding 'content'):
- content: React.ReactNode — required, tooltip text/content
- side: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' (default: 'top')

Wraps its children. Shows on hover and focus.

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Save your changes">
  <Button>Save</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

---

## Popover

Import: `import { Popover } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, excluding 'content'):
- content: React.ReactNode — required
- side: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' (default: 'bottom')
- open: boolean — controlled
- onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void

Wraps its children. Opens on click.

```tsx
<Popover content={<div><p>Popover content</p></div>}>
  <Button variant="outline">Options</Button>
</Popover>
```

---

## Menu + MenuItem + MenuSeparator + MenuLabel

Import: `import { Menu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel } from 'harmonium'`

Menu props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, renders role="menu"): no custom props.

MenuItem props (extends `<button>` HTML attributes):
- variant: 'default' | 'danger' (default: 'default')

MenuSeparator: extends `<div>` HTML attributes, renders role="separator", no custom props.
MenuLabel: extends `<div>` HTML attributes, no custom props.

```tsx
<Menu>
  <MenuLabel>Actions</MenuLabel>
  <MenuItem onClick={handleEdit}>Edit</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem onClick={handleDuplicate}>Duplicate</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem variant="danger" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

---

## CommandPalette

Import: `import { CommandPalette } from 'harmonium'`
Types: `import type { CommandItem } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- open: boolean
- onClose: () => void
- items: CommandItem[] — required
- placeholder: string (default: 'Type a command...')

CommandItem: { id: string, label: string, group?: string, onSelect: () => void }

```tsx
const commands = [
  { id: '1', label: 'Go to Dashboard', group: 'Navigation', onSelect: () => navigate('/') },
  { id: '2', label: 'Go to Settings', group: 'Navigation', onSelect: () => navigate('/settings') },
  { id: '3', label: 'Create New Project', group: 'Actions', onSelect: () => setShowNew(true) },
]

<CommandPalette open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} items={commands} />
```

---

## Toast (ToastProvider + useToast)

Import: `import { ToastProvider, useToast } from 'harmonium'`

ToastProvider props:
- children: React.ReactNode — required
- position: 'top-right' | 'top-left' | 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' (default: 'bottom-right')

useToast() returns: { toast, dismiss }
- toast(options): string — creates a toast, returns ID
- dismiss(id: string): void

Toast options:
- message: React.ReactNode
- variant: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
- duration: number (default: 5000, 0 = persistent)

```tsx
// Wrap your app
<ToastProvider position="bottom-right">
  <App />
</ToastProvider>

// In any component
function SaveButton() {
  const { toast } = useToast()

  return (
    <Button onClick={() => toast({ message: 'Saved!', variant: 'success' })}>
      Save
    </Button>
  )
}
```

---

## Field + FieldLabel + FieldDescription + FieldError

Import: `import { Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError } from 'harmonium'`

Field provides context that auto-wires accessibility attributes (id, htmlFor, aria-describedby, aria-errormessage) to child form controls (Input, Textarea, Select, NumberInput, DatePicker, TimePicker).

Field props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- error: boolean

FieldLabel: extends `<label>` HTML attributes, auto-connects htmlFor. No custom props.
FieldDescription: extends `<p>` HTML attributes, auto-sets id for aria-describedby. No custom props.
FieldError: extends `<p>` HTML attributes, auto-sets id for aria-errormessage, adds role="alert". No custom props.

```tsx
<Field error={!!errors.email}>
  <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
  <FieldDescription>We'll never share your email.</FieldDescription>
  <Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
</Field>
```

---

## Input

Import: `import { Input } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding native 'size'):
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

Field-context-aware: auto-wires id, aria-describedby, aria-errormessage, aria-invalid.

```tsx
<Input placeholder="Search..." size="md" />
<Input type="password" size="lg" />
```

---

## Textarea

Import: `import { Textarea } from 'harmonium'`

Props: extends `<textarea>` HTML attributes. No custom props beyond native attributes.
Field-context-aware.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Bio</FieldLabel>
  <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Tell us about yourself..." />
</Field>
```

---

## Select

Import: `import { Select } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<select>` HTML attributes, excluding native 'size'):
- placeholder: string
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

Field-context-aware.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Country</FieldLabel>
  <Select placeholder="Choose a country">
    <option value="us">United States</option>
    <option value="uk">United Kingdom</option>
    <option value="ca">Canada</option>
  </Select>
</Field>
```

Import: `import { Checkbox } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type'):
- label: React.ReactNode

```tsx
<Checkbox label="I agree to the terms" checked={agreed} onChange={handleChange} />
<Checkbox label="Subscribe to newsletter" />
```

## Radio + RadioGroup

Import: `import { Radio, RadioGroup } from 'harmonium'`

RadioGroup props (extends `<fieldset>` HTML attributes):
- legend: React.ReactNode

Radio props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type'):
- label: React.ReactNode

```tsx
<RadioGroup legend="Plan" name="plan">
  <Radio label="Free" value="free" />
  <Radio label="Pro" value="pro" />
  <Radio label="Enterprise" value="enterprise" />
</RadioGroup>
```

## Switch

Import: `import { Switch } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type', 'role', 'size'):
- label: React.ReactNode
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

Renders as `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`.

```tsx
<Switch label="Dark mode" checked={darkMode} onChange={toggleDarkMode} />
<Switch label="Notifications" size="sm" />
```

---

## NumberInput

Import: `import { NumberInput } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type', 'size', 'onChange', 'value', 'defaultValue'):
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')
- step: number (default: 1)
- min: number
- max: number
- value: number — controlled
- defaultValue: number (default: 0)
- onChange: (value: number) => void

Field-context-aware.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Quantity</FieldLabel>
  <NumberInput min={0} max={100} step={1} value={qty} onChange={setQty} />
</Field>
```

## Slider

Import: `import { Slider } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type', 'size'):
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')
- showValue: boolean

Renders as `<input type="range">`.

```tsx
<Slider min={0} max={100} value={volume} onChange={handleChange} showValue />
```

## Combobox

Import: `import { Combobox } from 'harmonium'`
Types: `import type { ComboboxOption } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, excluding 'onChange'):
- options: ComboboxOption[] — required
- value: string — controlled
- onChange: (value: string) => void
- placeholder: string (default: 'Search...')
- disabled: boolean

ComboboxOption: { value: string, label: string }

```tsx
const countries = [
  { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
  { value: 'uk', label: 'United Kingdom' },
  { value: 'ca', label: 'Canada' },
]

<Combobox options={countries} value={country} onChange={setCountry} placeholder="Select country" />
```

## MultiSelect

Import: `import { MultiSelect } from 'harmonium'`
Types: `import type { MultiSelectOption } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, excluding 'onChange'):
- options: MultiSelectOption[] — required
- value: string[] (default: [])
- onChange: (value: string[]) => void
- placeholder: string (default: 'Select...')
- disabled: boolean

MultiSelectOption: { value: string, label: string }

```tsx
const tags = [
  { value: 'react', label: 'React' },
  { value: 'typescript', label: 'TypeScript' },
  { value: 'css', label: 'CSS' },
]

<MultiSelect options={tags} value={selectedTags} onChange={setSelectedTags} />
```

Renders as `<input type="date">`. Field-context-aware.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Start Date</FieldLabel>
  <DatePicker value={startDate} onChange={handleChange} />
</Field>
```

## TimePicker

Import: `import { TimePicker } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<input>` HTML attributes, excluding 'type', 'size'):
- size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default: 'md')

Renders as `<input type="time">`. Field-context-aware.

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Meeting Time</FieldLabel>
  <TimePicker value={time} onChange={handleChange} />
</Field>
```

## FileUpload

Import: `import { FileUpload } from 'harmonium'`

Props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes, excluding 'onChange'):
- accept: string — file type filter (e.g. 'image/*,.pdf')
- multiple: boolean
- disabled: boolean
- onChange: (files: File[]) => void
- maxSize: number — max file size in bytes

```tsx
<FileUpload
  accept="image/*"
  multiple
  maxSize={5_000_000}
  onChange={(files) => setFiles(files)}
/>
```

---

## Stepper + Step

Import: `import { Stepper, Step } from 'harmonium'`

Stepper props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- activeStep: number — required, 0-based index
- orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' (default: 'horizontal')

Step props (extends `<div>` HTML attributes):
- label: string — required
- description: string

Stepper automatically injects `stepNumber` and `data-state` ('completed' | 'active' | 'pending') into Step children.

```tsx
<Stepper activeStep={1}>
  <Step label="Account" description="Create your account" />
  <Step label="Profile" description="Fill in your profile" />
  <Step label="Review" description="Review and submit" />
</Stepper>
```

---

## Common Composition Patterns

### Login Form
```tsx
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, Field, FieldLabel, FieldError, Input, Button, Stack } from 'harmonium'
import 'harmonium/styles.css'

function LoginForm() {
  return (
    <Card variant="outlined" style={{ maxWidth: 400 }}>
      <CardHeader>Sign In</CardHeader>
      <CardBody>
        <Stack gap="md">
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
            <Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
          </Field>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel>Password</FieldLabel>
            <Input type="password" />
          </Field>
          <Button variant="primary" expanded>Sign In</Button>
        </Stack>
      </CardBody>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

### Settings Page
```tsx
import {
  Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent,
  Card, CardBody, Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, Input, Select,
  Switch, Stack, Group, Button, Separator, Avatar
} from 'harmonium'
import 'harmonium/styles.css'

function SettingsPage() {
  return (
    <Tabs defaultValue="profile">
      <TabsList>
        <TabsTrigger value="profile">Profile</TabsTrigger>
        <TabsTrigger value="notifications">Notifications</TabsTrigger>
        <TabsTrigger value="security">Security</TabsTrigger>
      </TabsList>

      <TabsContent value="profile">
        <Card>
          <CardBody>
            <Stack gap="lg">
              <Group gap="md" align="center">
                <Avatar src="/photo.jpg" size="xl" />
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm">Change Photo</Button>
              </Group>
              <Separator />
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Display Name</FieldLabel>
                <Input defaultValue="Jane Doe" />
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
                <FieldDescription>Used for notifications</FieldDescription>
                <Input type="email" defaultValue="jane@example.com" />
              </Field>
              <Group justify="end">
                <Button>Save Changes</Button>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </TabsContent>

      <TabsContent value="notifications">
        <Card>
          <CardBody>
            <Stack gap="md">
              <Switch label="Email notifications" defaultChecked />
              <Switch label="Push notifications" />
              <Switch label="SMS notifications" />
            </Stack>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </TabsContent>

      <TabsContent value="security">
        <Card>
          <CardBody>
            <Stack gap="md">
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>Current Password</FieldLabel>
                <Input type="password" />
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel>New Password</FieldLabel>
                <Input type="password" />
              </Field>
              <Group justify="end">
                <Button>Update Password</Button>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  )
}
```

### Data Table Page
```tsx
import {
  DataGrid, Card, CardBody, CardHeader, Group, Input, Badge, Button, Pagination
} from 'harmonium'
import 'harmonium/styles.css'

function UsersPage() {
  const columns = [
    { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
    { key: 'email', header: 'Email', sortable: true },
    {
      key: 'status',
      header: 'Status',
      render: (user) => (
        <Badge variant={user.status === 'active' ? 'success' : 'neutral'}>
          {user.status}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
  ]

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <Group justify="between" align="center">
          <h2>Users</h2>
          <Input placeholder="Search users..." size="sm" style={{ maxWidth: 250 }} />
        </Group>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardBody>
        <DataGrid columns={columns} data={users} rowKey={(u) => u.id} striped hoverable />
        <Pagination page={page} totalPages={totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />
      </CardBody>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
